description: This file contains GPU-accelerated binary operations (such as addition, subtraction, comparison, etc.) optimized for Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) on Apple hardware within the PyTorch framework. It defines structures, utility functions, and macro-generated functions to implement various binary operations on tensors, with focus on interoperability with MPSGraph for GPU computation.

classes.name: BinaryOpCachedGraph
classes.description: A structure that caches a computational graph for binary operations using MPS, holding references to primary input tensors and output tensors.

methods.name: binaryOpTensor
methods.description: Performs a binary tensor operation using MPSGraph, handling tensor shape inference, type promotion, caching, and execution.

methods.name: binaryOpScalar
methods.description: Performs a binary operation between a tensor and a scalar, internally calling binaryOpTensor with a scalar tensor.

methods.name: add_sub_lerp_template
methods.description: Implements addition, subtraction, and linear interpolation operations with optimizations for zero or one scalar coefficients.
